searchText: Hi, could someone remind me what's the expected response status code for the GET blob sidecars API, when there aren’t enough columns to reconstruct blobs? I believe we had agree on this, but I couldn't find this in the beacon API spec - happy to do a PR. last i recall was this discussion in Aug: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1252403418941624532/1268195044280631306 Seems like we ended on `so maybe something to re-think through once the other decision is made`, We might need to re-discuss things with the current peerDAS status now
